lines.en: My plates shine brighter now
I push forward with ki behind me
My speed has picked up
I cut through the low air
I walk on points of light
My shadow has grown darker
I step over a broken wall
I approach without a sound
I leave the current behind
I sink low and glide
I press the ground with each step
I angle around and come in
This form is different
I hold my ki very steady
I can hear your heartbeat
Light shows between my plates
I need no more words
Light travels along my arms
I flex my knuckles once
I am planning my next dodge
The wind scatters on me
My patience has not changed
I wait for an opening
The ground glows beneath me
I even quiet my breathing
You can tell I have changed

lines.zh: 我比你上次见到时更快
lines.en: I am faster than last you saw
I memorize your ki at a glance
You still have the nerve to stand

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你的时候很静
lines.en: My gaze is very quiet now
What you hold is trembling
I see every hole in you

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这个形态
lines.en: Your armor fails this form
I tilt my head and let you pass
You think I have slowed
Have you planned your retreat
I smile once and stop

lines.zh: 你脚下那条影子，是我压下来的。
lines.en: That shadow at your feet is the one I press down.
I see you are still standing there
I memorize your breathing
Are you still watching me
I study how you hold your fist

lines.zh: 我换了形态，你握剑的手在抖。
lines.en: I changed form, and your sword hand is shaking.
I take it on my forearm
I give half a step and stop
I dodged half a beat late
That caught me at a seam
I reopen the distance

lines.zh: 气从甲缝漏走，我咬紧牙关。
lines.en: Chi leaks from my armor seams; I clench my teeth.
This form costs, and I know it
I can hold out a long while
Your punches have gained weight
This form burns only ki
What you bring is useless
I do not fight on food
I push it away with one hand
My appetite is long gone
Feed it to someone else
Do not leave it on the field
That is not food I smell

lines.zh: 你的好意我收下，东西不收
lines.en: I take your courtesy, not the food
You hit my flank
I turn with your force
You miss and hit the stone
I shift aside and let you pass
You only caught my plate edge
My footing does not shift
You are thrown back
That one hurt you more
I brush the dust off my shoulder
Close range gives you nothing
This form is not for such things
All my time goes to fighting
I hold my place alone
Do not ask me this again

lines.zh: 我的编号不写在族谱上
lines.en: My number is on no family tree
Only opponents are worth remembering
I plan to leave nothing behind
Silence will do
That question does not apply
I set the subject down
I pick up a broken plate
This one fell from me
I press it back into place
I pinch up a stone
It breaks in my hand
I throw it out of the arena
I keep it to remind me
This looks familiar
I open my hand and look
I drop it in a pocket
I have your position worked out
This strike will be quick
I am done testing you
I take your front diagonal
You are printed in my sight
I gather ki in my palm
I move before your hand lifts
I take the shortest line
Your gap is on the right ribs
I want this fight short
I fix on your center of weight
You only see half of me
I strike sooner than you think
No one is coming for you

lines.zh: 我决定用这个形态收尾
lines.en: This form will finish it
You are inside my circle
I send the afterimage first
I have your dodges memorized
I take a different angle
My read is sharper this time
Retreating faster will not help
I stay tight on you
Your ki is leaking out
Left or right, which do you guess
Your guard is sinking
I trace an arc around you
I predicted your third move
Your weapon is heating up
I do not need to chase
Your ki gathers on the right
You are sealed inside my range
My palm slips through your guard
Blasts fire between my fingers
I strike your open right side
My fist lands on your nape
You guard the front, the back is open
Ki sweeps out along my leg
I kick your wrist
I catch you in the air

lines.zh: 这一击带着闪身的速度
lines.en: This blow carries dodge speed
The ground splits as I land it
You back off, I close again
There is no gap between the two
I drive my shoulder plate in

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护甲接缝
lines.en: That one finds your armor seam

lines.zh: 你听得见光炸开的声音
lines.en: You hear the light burst
My shape condenses out of ki
Plate after plate clicks into place
I land at the far end of the field
Light scatters off my shoulders
The wind dies as I look up
This form steadies itself
I am out, and stronger than before
Ki lifts the stones beneath me
I swallow the torchlight
I walk out of shadow into light

lines.zh: 你听见甲片相碰的声音
lines.en: You hear plates knock together
I open the ki in my hands
A new form, the same target
My ki blasts the arena open
I stand before you, plates wide
Waking a second time, I am clearer
I am in place before the dust lands
Fire climbs along my plates

lines.zh: 落地时我单膝沉了一下
lines.en: I land and drop to one knee
Water seals my ki vents
The blast pushes me two steps
An arrow glances off my plate

lines.zh: 咒力打断了我的一次闪身
lines.en: Magic breaks one of my dodges
I burn ki too fast and start to fade

lines.zh: 雷击让我半边身子发麻
lines.en: The strike numbs half my body
My ki scatters as I drop
